description: Wave 1 — August 2026 evidence research. 40 entries covering ELITE (6), ROSE (18), and SKYE (16) collections. All note evidence sourced from Tier 1 (official brand sites) or Tier 2 (Fragrantica, Basenotes, major authoritative retailers) sources via WebSearch and WebFetch. LLM general knowledge is NOT used as a governed source.

governance.researchedBy: Claude Code — EP-CAT-P3C-R1 Wave 1 Research Campaign (WebSearch + WebFetch)

sourcePolicyTiers.tier2: Fragrantica.com, Basenotes.net, major authorised retailers (John Lewis, Macy's, Sephora, Nordstrom, Harvey Nichols)

governance.admissibilityNote: LLM general knowledge is NOT admissible as a governed source. All claims in this file are traceable to a named external source. Where a direct WebFetch returned 403 or insufficient content, evidence is from search result snippets citing the source — classified HIGH rather than AUTHORITATIVE.
governance.schemaNote: This file follows the ResearchSourceEntry schema from scripts/identity/ingestion/types.ts. Non-standard extension fields (evidenceSources, conflicts, yearDiscrepancyFlag, founderSupplied, editionOptions) are included for governance tracking. The ingestion script ignores unrecognised fields.
governance.noteStructureNote: Where a brand presents notes as an unordered bouquet (not a top/heart/base pyramid), notes appear in heartNotes[] only; topNotes[] and baseNotes[] are left empty. This is intentional — per Founder instruction, pyramid structure must NOT be forced onto brands that do not use it.

entries._sourceKey: UNISEX-56-Rose Oud All fragrances are inspired by the listed designer brands. Brand names are trademarks of their respective owners. Prices available on request.
entries.supplierName: Rose Oud All fragrances are inspired by the listed designer brands. Brand names are trademarks of their respective owners. Prices available on request.
entries.sourceNotes: Top and heart notes sourced from Founder-supplied clarification (EP-CAT-P3A disposition, 2026-08-15) — classified AUTHORITATIVE. Base notes also Founder-supplied (Agarwood/Oud, Cypriol Oil/Nagarmotha, Cedarwood, smoky leather nuances). External source corroboration via WebSearch snippets referencing bykilian.com confirms: Top: Bulgarian Rose, Saffron, Cinnamon; Heart: Tincture of Rose, Litchi — consistent with Founder. CONFLICT: External source (bykilian.com search snippet) lists 'Guaiac Wood' in base alongside Agarwood (Oud), Cypriol Oil/Nagarmotha, Cedar. Guaiac Wood does NOT appear in Founder-supplied base notes. Founder note also mentions 'smoky leather nuances' which is an accord description, not a discrete ingredient — omitted from baseNotes[] per evidence standards. Conflict is flagged for Founder review; Founder-supplied notes are preserved as canonical base per Amendment 4 instructions.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier text is corrupted — PDF extraction concatenated the supplier's legal boilerplate footer into the product name field. Canonical identity resolved via Founder clarification in disposition file: Kilian Paris Rose Oud.
entries.founderOlfactoryNuance: smoky leather nuances — Founder-supplied olfactory accord description for Rose Oud. Not a discrete ingredient; excluded from baseNotes[] per evidence standards. May inform editorial character description. Preserved here for factory context.

founderResolution.decision: Canonical note set confirmed. baseNotes remain: Agarwood (Oud), Cypriol Oil/Nagarmotha, Cedarwood. Guaiac Wood is NOT added to the canonical baseNotes array. The external source variance is preserved as EXTERNAL_SOURCE_VARIANCE evidence and must not be silently merged into the canonical set.

conflicts.disposition: EXTERNAL_SOURCE_VARIANCE — Guaiac Wood appears in external source (bykilian.com) but is NOT present in Founder-authorized canonical notes. Founder resolution (EP-CAT-P3C-R1, 2026-08-15): canonical baseNotes are confirmed as Agarwood (Oud), Cypriol Oil/Nagarmotha, Cedarwood. Guaiac Wood is excluded from the canonical set. This variance record must be preserved and must not be silently merged into the canonical baseNotes.

entries.sourceNotes: Supplier typo: 'H24 Herbs Vives' — correct: 'H24 Herbes Vives'. Canonical name: Hermès H24 Herbes Vives EDP (2024). Notes per Hermès official minimal presentation style (hermes.com): herbal notes / pear / Physcool® (a high-tech cooling molecule). Hermès presents this as a 'bouquet of fresh herbs + pear granita texture + Physcool® liveliness' — a deliberately sparse note structure. Fragrantica provides a more detailed note profile (anise, galbanum, mint, pear, Physcool®, green notes, oakmoss, ambrette) but the official Hermès 3-element presentation is the Tier 1 authoritative source. Launch year 2024 per Fragrantica and hermès.com. Christine Nagel credited as perfumer.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier text 'H24 Herbs Vives' contains a typo — 'Herbs' should be 'Herbes' (French). The canonical product name is 'H24 Herbes Vives'. Identity is unambiguous; only a spelling correction is required.
